sentences.text: Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. S BANIK Advocate for the Respondent : GA, ASSAM

BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE MANISH CHOUDHURY  ORDER Date : 11.10.2023 Mr. S. Banik, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. P.K. Sharma, learned Standing Counsel, Assam Tourism Development Corporation [ATDC] for the respondent nos. 2 & 3 have submitted that another writ petition, W.P.[C] no. 5687/2022, involving similar issues, is pending.

Mr. Sharma has further submitted that the respondent ATDC authorities are going to file a counter affidavit in the other writ petition which would cover the issues raised in the present writ petition also and such counter affidavit will be filed within 2 [two] days' time.
The learned counsel for the parties have, therefore, submitted that this writ petition be listed after 2 [two] weeks along with W.P.[C] no. 5687/2022.
List this writ petition along with W.P.[C] no. 5687/2022 on 17.11.2023.
